title: fungus
description: A kingdom of organism: a heterotroph with a chitin cell wall whose body is a growing absorptive network rather than a bounded shape. Feeds by extracellular digestion; central decomposer and symbiont. An organism refined by heterotrophy, the chitin wall, and the mycelial network body.

heterotrophic.description: obtains carbon from other organisms; cannot photosynthesize

network-bodied.description: the body is a hyphal network (mycelium), not a discrete individual
